formulation: wgan + r1(1) + path-secant(10,t=0.5) + cap-all(10,c=1) [Dβ2=0.9] + K3P EMA-anchor(0.5*prox,decay=0.999)

anchor.term: loss_weight * mean ||grad D(real) - grad Dbar(real)||^2 / d
anchor.start: critic step 1 (Dbar = initial D), EMA update after every critic step

init_receipt.applied_via: recipe.make_prior + recipe.make_optimizers(G, D, prior); anchor EMA = deepcopy(D) after
